title_en: Dongfang Electric Group Dongfang Turbine Co., Ltd. v. Daqing High-tech Industrial Development Zone Dafeng Construction and Installation Co., Ltd. and Daqing Dafeng Energy Technology Service Co., Ltd. — dispute over a sales contract
ruling_gist_en: After delivery of the goods sold, if the buyer has already used the subject matter and has not raised any quality objection within the agreed quality warranty period, when the seller demands payment of the outstanding purchase price and return of the warranty deposit, the buyer's claim to exercise the right to defense of prior performance on the ground of quality defects shall not be supported.
keywords_en: civil; dispute over sales contract; second instance; Supreme People's Court; Heilongjiang Province; Sichuan Province; legal person; Contract Law; quality objection period; right of defense of prior performance; collateral obligation and principal obligation; partially supported; sale of wind turbine generators; quality warranty period; delivery of technical documents; good faith; contract dispute; sales contract; guarantee; sales contract dispute of a service limited company
full_text_en:
东方电气集团东方汽轮机有限公司与大庆高新技术产业开发区大丰建筑安装有限公司、大庆大丰能源技术服务有限公司买卖合同纠纷案

Dongfang Electric Corporation Dongfang Steam Turbine Co., Ltd. v. Daqing High-tech Industrial Development Zone Dafeng Construction & Installation Co., Ltd. and Daqing Dafeng Energy Technology Service Co., Ltd. — dispute over a sales contract

【裁判摘要】

After the delivery of goods, if the buyer has used the subject matter and has not raised any quality objection within the agreed quality warranty period, and the seller demands payment of the outstanding purchase price and return of the quality guarantee deposit, the buyer's defense based on the right of prior performance on the ground of quality defects shall not be supported.

The delivery of technical materials is a subsidiary performance obligation of the seller. If the seller breaches this obligation, the buyer may claim corresponding liability for breach of contract. However, if the seller's breach of the subsidiary obligation does not affect the buyer's normal use of the purchased goods and does not impede the realization of the contract purpose, the buyer may not refuse to perform the principal obligation of paying the purchase price based solely on the seller's breach of the subsidiary obligation.

最高人民法院民事判决书

(2019) 最高法民终185号

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court
No. 185 (2019) Final Civil

上诉人（原审被告）：大庆高新技术产业开发区大丰建筑安装有限公司。住所地：黑龙江省大庆高新区创业新街14号科技创业园（园区）创新大厦219室。
Appellant (Defendant at First Instance): Daqing High-tech Industrial Development Zone Dafeng Construction & Installation Co., Ltd. Domicile: Room 219, Innovation Building, Science and Technology Innovation Park (Park), No. 14 Chuangye New Street, Daqing High-tech Zone, Heilongjiang Province.

法定代表人：庞洪波，该公司总经理。
Legal Representative: Pang Hongbo, General Manager of the company.

委托诉讼代理人：李加力，黑龙江司洋律师事务所律师。
Agent ad litem: Li Jiali, lawyer, Heilongjiang Siyang Law Firm.

委托诉讼代理人：谢春雷，黑龙江司洋律师事务所律师。
Agent ad litem: Xie Chunlei, lawyer, Heilongjiang Siyang Law Firm.

被上诉人（原审原告）：东方电气集团东方汽轮机有限公司。住所地：四川省德阳市高新技术产业园区金沙江西路666号。
Appellee (Plaintiff at First Instance): Dongfang Electric Corporation Dongfang Steam Turbine Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 666 Jinshajiang West Road, High-tech Industrial Park, Deyang City, Sichuan Province.

法定代表人：马义，该公司董事长。
Legal Representative: Ma Yi, Chairman of the company.

委托诉讼代理人：马方平，四川仁竞律师事务所律师。
Agent ad litem: Ma Fangping, lawyer, Sichuan Renjing Law Firm.

委托诉讼代理人：姜辉，四川仁竞律师事务所律师。
Agent ad litem: Jiang Hui, lawyer, Sichuan Renjing Law Firm.

原审被告：大庆大丰能源技术服务有限公司。住所地：黑龙江省大庆市高新区。
Defendant at First Instance: Daqing Dafeng Energy Technology Service Co., Ltd. Domicile: Daqing High-tech Zone, Heilongjiang Province.

法定代表人：刘兆明，该公司董事长。
Legal Representative: Liu Zhaoming, Chairman of the company.

上诉人大庆高新技术产业开发区大丰建筑安装有限公司（以下简称大丰建安公司）因与被上诉人东方电气集团东方汽轮机有限公司（以下简称东方汽轮机公司）、原审被告大庆大丰能源技术服务有限公司（以下简称大丰服务公司）买卖合同纠纷一案，不服黑龙江省高级人民法院于2018年10月15日作出的(2018)黑民初34号民事判决，向本院提起上诉。本院依法组成由主审法官王富博担任审判长，主审法官张代恩、宋春雨为成员的合议庭对本案进行了审理，书记员黄婷婷担任记录工作。大丰建安公司委托诉讼代理人李加力、东方汽轮机公司委托诉讼代理人马方平、姜辉到庭参加诉讼。本案现已审理终结。
In the case of dispute over a sales contract between the appellant Daqing High-tech Industrial Development Zone Dafeng Construction & Installation Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dafeng Construction and Installation Company) and the appellee Dongfang Electric Corporation Dongfang Steam Turbine Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dongfang Steam Turbine Company) and the defendant at first instance Daqing Dafeng Energy Technology Service Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dafeng Service Company), the appellant appealed to this Court against the civil judgment (2018) Hei Min Chu No. 34 rendered by the Heilongjiang High People's Court on October 15, 2018. This Court lawfully formed a collegial panel with Presiding Judge Wang Fubo, and Judges Zhang Daien and Song Chunyu to hear the case, with Court Clerk Huang Tingting serving as recorder. Li Jiali, agent ad litem of Dafeng Construction and Installation Company, and Ma Fangping and Jiang Hui, agents ad litem of Dongfang Steam Turbine Company, appeared before the court. The case is now concluded.

大丰建安公司上诉请求依法撤销（2018）黑民初34号民事判决，改判大丰建安公司对东方汽轮机公司不予支付货款，驳回东方汽轮机公司的诉讼请求；诉讼费由东方汽轮机公司承担。主要事实和理由：原审法院认定事实不清，东方汽轮机公司在履行案涉合同中有多项违约事项。一、东方汽轮机公司没有修改案涉的《肇源项目买卖合同》（以下简称《买卖合同》）的权利。原审中，东方汽轮机公司提交的证据，是东方汽轮机公司于2015年8月13日委托东方电气风电有限公司（以下简称东方电气公司）签订的《风电业务委托协议》，其第16条“货款回收责任”，下属第(1)条明确，乙方（指东方电气公司）不得擅自更改、变更合同的收款方式、时间及金额，严格按照合同约定的条款实现货款回收。据此可见，东方电气公司于2016年4月18日签订的《林口、肇源项目会议纪要》（以下简称《会议纪要》）擅自改变了收款方式、收款时间，并未严格按合同（指案涉《买卖合同》4.2.4、4.2.5条）约定的条款回收货款。可见，所谓《会议纪要》是超越授权范围的行为。二、《会议纪要》将原《买卖合同》中卖方（东方汽轮机公司）的义务去掉，不正当实现付款条件。《会议纪要》引用合同4.2.4条时的表述为：根据合同4.2.4条签订的预验收之日起第4个年度第1个月支付预验收款，到2015年10月应支付验收款7138.8万元。而“——”号部分缺少已经预验收的内容，将东方汽轮机公司的义务去掉，如此使东方汽轮机公司不进行预验收就可以得到货款。《会议纪要》故意将原合同本方义务及对方权利去掉，促成未到期债权成为到期债权。可见东方汽轮机公司主张的到期债权是不成立的。三、东方汽轮机公司所供货物及技术服务存在严重质量问题，大丰建安公司享有先履行抗辩权。（一）在2017年10月27日，买卖方、使用方三方出具的《验收单》上共有十三个栏目，其中有十二个栏目记录为不合格。其中在第10栏、11栏记载，东方汽轮机公司自风电场运行开始一直没有提供机组试运行记录、机组预验收记录。这表明33台风电机组自运行以来没有进行过预验收。合同4.2.4条、4.2.5条约定，只有预验收合格，买卖双方及使用方“三方”签署预验收合格证书，并提供一式五份的预验收证书，才能支付全款的40%，直到如今，东方汽轮机公司也未能履行这些约定，所以不具备付款条件。（二）肇源新龙顺德风电场19#、23#、26#、27#、32#风力发电机组最终验收影音记录确认单经验收形成的验收影音记录5份确认单上，记录存在各种质量问题157项。以上证据充分证明东方汽轮机公司自2012年8月供货开始，一直存在严重违约行为，大丰建安公司应享有先履行抗辩权。四、东方汽轮机公司隐瞒了全部风电机组没有进行预验收的事实，案涉机组不具备最终验收条件，也未进行最终验收。东方汽轮机公司从风电机组进场后，就委派两名专业人员常年驻守在风电场，对风电场所有事实了如指掌，但是故意隐瞒33台机组没有预验收的事实，东方汽轮机公司在起草《会议纪要》时故意隐瞒案涉的风电机组没有进行预验收的事实。由于大丰建安公司是买方，是总承包方，不参与风电场的机组运行与维护，不了解风电机组是否预验收。《会议纪要》及《付款担保协议》签订是基于风机无质量问题的前提下签订的付款支付，是根据合同4.2.4条款基础上对付款时间进行约定。直到2017年10月27日东方汽轮机公司召开最终验收工作会议，大丰建安公司派代表参加，此人参加验收了五台风电机组，在形成的材料中了解到此前没有对风电机组进行预验收。最终验收也没有完成。五、原审法院认定东方汽轮机公司已依合同约定交付了货物是错误的。大丰建安公司提交的证据表明，东方汽轮机公司已自认自风电机组进场后有多份应交大丰建安公司的技术资料未提交，其也未依据合同约定进行试运行验收、预验收及最终验收。东方汽轮机公司所供货物的质量存在严重问题，已构成严重违约。原审法院对于这些均未查明，而错误地认定东方汽轮机公司已按合同约定完成交货任务，从而错误判决大丰建安公司应支付款项。六、东方汽轮机公司无权取回质保金，应判决1822.2万元质保金归大丰建安公司所有。根据合同4.2.5条款，全部机组通过最终验收，并由最终用户、买方、卖方签发最终验收证书后的第一个年度内，支付10%质保款（即1822.2万元）。《最高人民法院关于审理买卖合同纠纷案件适用法律问题的解释》第二十一条规定，“买受人依约保留部分价款作为质量保证金，出卖人在质量保证期间未及时解决质量问题而影响标的物的价值或使用效果，出卖人主张支付该部分价款的，人民法院不予支持”。从上述可见，东方汽轮机公司有诸多违约行为，且违约在先；东方汽轮机公司所供设备存在严重质量问题，而不肯修理与修复，应适用上述司法解释，请求法院判决将上述质保金1822.2万元判归大丰建安公司所有。
Dafeng Construction and Installation Company's appeal requests that the civil judgment (2018) Hei Min Chu No. 34 be vacated, that judgment be entered that Dafeng Construction and Installation Company does not owe payment to Dongfang Steam Turbine Company, and that Dongfang Steam Turbine Company's claims be dismissed; and that the litigation costs be borne by Dongfang Steam Turbine Company. The main facts and reasons are as follows: The court of first instance failed to ascertain the facts clearly, and Dongfang Steam Turbine Company had multiple breaches in performing the contract at issue.

1. Dongfang Steam Turbine Company did not have the right to modify the Zhaoyuan Project Sales Contract (hereinafter referred to as the Sales Contract). At first instance, the evidence submitted by Dongfang Steam Turbine Company was the Wind Power Business Entrustment Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the Entrustment Agreement), which Dongfang Steam Turbine Company entrusted Dongfang Electric Wind Power Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Dongfang Electric Company) to sign on August 13, 2015. Article 16 of the Entrustment Agreement, titled "Responsibility for Collection of Payment," under subparagraph (1), clearly provides that Party B (i.e., Dongfang Electric Company) shall not arbitrarily alter or change the collection method, time, and amount of payment, and shall strictly follow the contract terms to realize payment collection. Based on this, the Minutes of the Linkou and Zhaoyuan Project Meeting (hereinafter referred to as the Meeting Minutes) signed by Dongfang Electric Company on April 18, 2016, arbitrarily changed the collection method and time, and did not strictly follow the terms of the Sales Contract (specifically Articles 4.2.4 and 4.2.5) to collect payment. Therefore, the so-called Meeting Minutes constituted an act exceeding the scope of authority.

2. The Meeting Minutes removed the seller's (Dongfang Steam Turbine Company's) obligations under the original Sales Contract, improperly realizing payment conditions. The Meeting Minutes, when citing Article 4.2.4, stated: "According to Article 4.2.4 of the contract, the pre-acceptance fee shall be paid in the first month of the fourth year from the date of pre-acceptance. By October 2015, the acceptance fee of 71.388 million yuan should have been paid." However, the "---" portion omitted the content of pre-acceptance having been completed, thereby removing the obligation of Dongfang Steam Turbine Company, allowing it to receive payment without performing pre-acceptance. The Meeting Minutes intentionally removed the party's own obligations and the other party's rights, accelerating the maturity of a debt that was not yet due. Therefore, Dongfang Steam Turbine Company's claim for matured debt is untenable.

3. The goods and technical services supplied by Dongfang Steam Turbine Company had serious quality problems, giving Dafeng Construction and Installation Company a right of defense of prior performance. (a) On October 27, 2017, the Acceptance Certificate (验收单) issued by the seller, buyer, and end-user had thirteen columns, of which twelve columns were recorded as non-conforming. Columns 10 and 11 recorded that Dongfang Steam Turbine Company had not provided trial run records or pre-acceptance records of the units since the wind farm began operation. This indicates that the 33 wind turbine generator units had not undergone pre-acceptance since operation began. Articles 4.2.4 and 4.2.5 of the contract provide that only after pre-acceptance is passed and the "three parties" (seller, buyer, and end-user) sign the pre-acceptance certificate and provide five copies of the pre-acceptance certificate, can 40% of the total price be paid. To date, Dongfang Steam Turbine Company has not fulfilled these terms, so the conditions for payment are not met. (b) The five confirmation sheets of the final acceptance audio-visual records for Zhaoyuan Xinlong Shunde wind farm units No. 19, 23, 26, 27, and 32 recorded 157 various quality issues. The above evidence fully proves that since the commencement of supply in August 2012, Dongfang Steam Turbine Company has been in serious breach, and Dafeng Construction and Installation Company should be entitled to a right of defense of prior performance.

4. Dongfang Steam Turbine Company concealed the fact that all wind turbine units had not undergone pre-acceptance. The units at issue did not meet the conditions for final acceptance, and final acceptance has not been completed. After the wind turbine units arrived on site, Dongfang Steam Turbine Company dispatched two professionals to permanently reside at the wind farm, fully aware of all circumstances, but deliberately concealed the fact that the 33 units had not undergone pre-acceptance. When drafting the Meeting Minutes, Dongfang Steam Turbine Company deliberately concealed the fact that the wind turbine units had not undergone pre-acceptance. Since Dafeng Construction and Installation Company, as the buyer and general contractor, did not participate in the operation and maintenance of the wind farm units, it was unaware whether the units had been pre-accepted. The Meeting Minutes and the Payment Guarantee Agreement were signed on the premise that there were no quality issues with the wind turbines and were based on Article 4.2.4 to adjust the payment schedule. Not until October 27, 2017, when Dongfang Steam Turbine Company convened a final acceptance work meeting, did Dafeng Construction and Installation Company send a representative to participate in the acceptance of five wind turbine units, and from the materials produced, it learned that no pre-acceptance had been conducted. Final acceptance was also not completed.

5. The court of first instance erred in finding that Dongfang Steam Turbine Company had delivered the goods in accordance with the contract. Evidence submitted by Dafeng Construction and Installation Company shows that Dongfang Steam Turbine Company admitted that after the wind turbine units arrived on site, it had failed to submit multiple sets of technical documents that should have been provided to Dafeng Construction and Installation Company, and it also failed to conduct trial run acceptance, pre-acceptance, and final acceptance as required by the contract. The quality of the goods supplied by Dongfang Steam Turbine Company was seriously defective, constituting a material breach. The court of first instance failed to ascertain these facts and erroneously found that Dongfang Steam Turbine Company had completed delivery as contractually required, thereby incorrectly ruling that Dafeng Construction and Installation Company should make payment.

6. Dongfang Steam Turbine Company is not entitled to the return of the quality guarantee deposit. The court should rule that the quality guarantee deposit of 18.222 million yuan belongs to Dafeng Construction and Installation Company. Under Article 4.2.5 of the contract, 10% of the quality guarantee payment (i.e., 18.222 million yuan) shall be paid within the first year after all units pass final acceptance and the final acceptance certificate is issued by the end-user, buyer, and seller. Article 21 of the Judicial Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Sales Contract Disputes provides: "If the buyer retains part of the price as a quality guarantee deposit in accordance with the contract, and the seller fails to resolve the quality issues in a timely manner during the quality guarantee period, thereby affecting the value or use effect of the subject matter, the court shall not support the seller's claim for payment of that part of the price." As seen above, Dongfang Steam Turbine Company has committed multiple breaches, and these breaches occurred first; the equipment supplied by Dongfang Steam Turbine Company had serious quality defects and it refused to repair or remedy them. The above judicial interpretation should apply, and Dafeng Construction and Installation Company requests the court to rule that the quality guarantee deposit of 18.222 million yuan belongs to Dafeng Construction and Installation Company.

东方汽轮机公司答辩称：一、《会议纪要》系东方汽轮机公司委托东方电气公司签订，且在东方汽轮机公司与大丰建安公司签订的《付款担保协议》中对该《会议纪要》的内容进行了确认，双方亦按《会议纪要》约定履行了部分义务，故该《会议纪要》对原《买卖合同》的变更有效，是双方的真实意思表示。因此大丰建安公司认为东方汽轮机公司不正当实现付款条件没有法律和事实依据。二、《会议纪要》中所述“到2015年10月应支付验收款柒仟壹佰叁拾捌万捌仟元整”，《会议纪要》签订后，大丰建安公司仅支付了1600万元，于2017年1月起便不再支付。因此应当是东方汽轮机公司享有先履行抗辩权。大丰建安公司以其自己形成于2017年10月27日的证据抗辩认为其享有先履行抗辩权是不能成立的。东方汽轮机公司的证据《公证书》第54页，2016年2月29日大丰建安公司向东方汽轮机公司来函中“预验收证书签署时间为2012年10月…截至目前…合计应付款为71388000元”，大丰建安公司于《会议纪要》签订前的来函中就明确了其知晓预验收证书签订时间。《会议纪要》、《付款担保协议》已经将付款条件进行变更，双方应当按照约定履行，是否进行最终验收与付款及质保金的支付之间不再具有关联。2015年大丰建安公司就已经拖欠东方汽轮机公司货款，即使东方汽轮机公司未为其修理也是东方汽轮机公司合理的行使先履行抗辩权。大丰建安公司已经针对设备质量问题以及违约责任另行提起诉讼，其应当向东方汽轮机公司支付拖欠的货款和质保金。三、对东方汽轮机公司已完全履行发货义务的事实，既有双方签订的《会议纪要》的确认，亦有多份来往函件的证实，且大丰建安公司在一审过程中从未对此提出异议，故其抗辩东方汽轮机公司未依约交付货物是没有依据的。
Dongfang Steam Turbine Company responded in its defense: 1. The Meeting Minutes were signed by Dongfang Electric Company on behalf of Dongfang Steam Turbine Company, and the content of the Meeting Minutes was confirmed in the Payment Guarantee Agreement signed between Dongfang Steam Turbine Company and Dafeng Construction and Installation Company. Both parties also performed part of their obligations in accordance with the Meeting Minutes. Therefore, the amendments made by the Meeting Minutes to the original Sales Contract are valid and represent the true intent of both parties. Accordingly, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company's assertion that Dongfang Steam Turbine Company improperly realized payment conditions lacks legal and factual basis. 2. The Meeting Minutes stated that "by October 2015, the acceptance fee of RMB 71,388,000 shall be paid." After the Meeting Minutes were signed, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company only paid 16 million yuan and stopped paying from January 2017 onward. Therefore, it is Dongfang Steam Turbine Company that should be entitled to the right of defense of prior performance. Dafeng Construction and Installation Company's defense based on its own evidence created on October 27, 2017, is untenable. According to page 54 of the notarized evidence (公证书) submitted by Dongfang Steam Turbine Company, in a letter dated February 29, 2016, addressed to Dongfang Steam Turbine Company, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company stated: "The pre-acceptance certificate was signed in October 2012... Up to now... the total amount payable is 71,388,000 yuan." This shows that prior to the signing of the Meeting Minutes, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company was already aware of the signing date of the pre-acceptance certificate. The Meeting Minutes and the Payment Guarantee Agreement have modified the payment conditions, and both parties should perform in accordance with these documents. Whether final acceptance has occurred is no longer relevant to the payment of the purchase price and the quality guarantee deposit. As early as 2015, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company was already in arrears on payment to Dongfang Steam Turbine Company. Even if Dongfang Steam Turbine Company failed to make repairs, it was merely exercising its own reasonable right of defense of prior performance. Dafeng Construction and Installation Company has already filed a separate lawsuit concerning equipment quality issues and liability for breach of contract. It should pay the overdue purchase price and quality guarantee deposit to Dongfang Steam Turbine Company. 3. The fact that Dongfang Steam Turbine Company fully performed its delivery obligation is confirmed by both the Meeting Minutes signed by the parties and multiple items of correspondence. Moreover, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company never raised any objection to this fact during the first instance proceedings. Therefore, its defense that Dongfang Steam Turbine Company failed to deliver goods as contractually required is groundless.

东方汽轮机公司向原审法院起诉请求：1.判令大丰建安公司给付肇源项目货款4961万元及基于该货款产生至支付货款日，按中国人民银行同期贷款利率计算的利息；2.判令大丰服务公司承担连带保证责任；3.大丰建安公司、大丰服务公司承担本案诉讼费用。
Dongfang Steam Turbine Company filed its claims with the court of first instance, requesting: 1. that Dafeng Construction and Installation Company be ordered to pay the purchase price of 49.61 million yuan for the Zhaoyuan Project, plus interest calculated from the date the payment became due until the date of actual payment, at the loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China for the corresponding period; 2. that Dafeng Service Company be ordered to assume joint and several suretyship liability; and 3. that Dafeng Construction and Installation Company and Dafeng Service Company bear the litigation costs of this case.

原审法院认定事实：2011年8月，东方电气集团东方汽轮机有限公司大安风电分公司（以下简称大安分公司）与大丰建安公司签订了《买卖合同》（合同编号DTC/C51C20112），约定：大丰建安公司向大安分公司购买33套FD82B低温型风力发电机组（1.5MW及以上单机容量），合同单位千瓦综合造价3560元/KW，总价款17322万元。包括风电机组设备、监控系统、备品备件和易耗品、专用工具及与设备有关的一切税、费和运杂费、保险费、技术资料费等费用。另外，技术服务费为300万元，总计17622万元。合同生效日期起，大丰建安公司在收到大安分公司履约保函（合同总价的10%）和合同价格10%的财务收据审核无误后15个工作日内，支付合同总价款10%作为预付款；大安分公司发货前，提交合同价款20%的财务收据，大丰建安公司审核无误后15个工作日内，支付合同总价款20%的货款；大安分公司在全部33套设备交货完成后提交合同价款20%的财务收据及合同价款100%的增值税发票1份，大丰建安公司核对无误后15个工作日内，支付合同总价款20%的货款，同时退还总价款5%的银行履约保函；全部33套机组通过预验收之日起第4个年度的第一个月内，大安分公司提交总价款40%的财务收据及由该公司、最终用户、大丰建安公司共同签署的设备预验收证书，大丰建安公司收到财务收据及预验收证书经审核无误后15个工作日内，支付合同总价款40%的货款，同时退还总价款5%的银行履约保函；全部33套机组通过最终验收，并由最终用户、大丰建安公司、大安分公司共同签署最终验收证书后第一个年度内，大安分公司提交总价款10%的财务收据及最终验收证书，大丰建安公司收到财务收据及最终验收证书经审核无误后15个工作日内，支付合同总价款10%的货款。设备通过机组性能验收试验，预验收证书经大丰建安公司、大安分公司、最终用户签署后，大安分公司提交技术服务费总价70%的商业发票，大丰建安公司审核后支付70%的技术服务费；最终用户、大丰建安公司、大安分公司签署最终验收证书，大安分公司提交技术服务费总价30%的发票，大丰建安公司审核无误后，支付剩余30%的技术服务费。设备的交货期及交货顺序应满足工程建设安装进度和顺序的要求，保证交货及时和设备的完整性。工具和备品、备件随第一批合同设备一起运输到达现场，交货地点为肇源新龙顺德风电场现场设备安装地点（车面）。供货时间为：2011年10月30日到11月30日供货11套；2011年12月1日到12月30日供货11套；2012年1月1日到1月30日供货11套，最终准确的供货时间以大丰建安公司提前3个月书面通知时间为准。2012年10月15日，大安分公司与案涉风力发电机组的业主方肇源新龙顺德风力发电有限公司（以下简称新龙顺德公司）共同对33套风力发电机组进行验收，并在验收证书上签字、盖章。2012年11月5日，新龙顺德公司在大安分公司提供的大庆肇源新龙顺德风场正式进入质保期报告上签字、盖章，确认33台风机已于2012年11月4日20点完成240小时验收工作，风机运行正常，满足验收要求，从2012年11月6日正式进入质保期。2016年4月18日，大丰建安公司与东方电气公司就林口、肇源项目的付款和履行情况进行协商，并形成了《会议纪要》，载明：肇源风电场从2011年12月开始发货，根据合同约定预验收之日起第4个年度的第一个月支付预验收款，到2015年10月应支付验收款71388000元，在最终验收证书签到后第一个年度内支付质保金18222000元。具体付款计划为：2016年5月开始付款，每月付款200万元。剩余欠款从2017年1月开始每月付款600万元，到2017年底将预验收款及质保金全部支付完毕。如大丰建安公司未按上述付款计划支付货款，将按中国人民银行同期贷款基准利率支付延期付款期间的利息。肇源项目东方电气公司有权在未按期付款的次月开始停止该项目相关支持及运维工作，由此影响风电场发电量及造成风电场一切后果风险，东方电气公司不承担任何责任。项目后续由于停机重新启动需要部套件整改所产生的费用由大丰建安公司承担。2016年7月17日，大丰建安公司、大丰服务公司与东方汽轮机公司签订《付款担保协议》，约定：大安分公司是东方汽轮机公司的分支机构，肇源项目的一切权利、义务均由东方汽轮机公司承接。肇源项目应付预验收款及质保金共计为8961万元，大丰建安公司应付给大安分公司的全部款项直接付给东方汽轮机公司，该款项大安分公司的供货义务已经履行完毕。具体付款比例、额度、期限仍按《会议纪要》执行，大丰服务公司为肇源项目款项的支付承担连带担保责任。大丰建安公司于2011年9月支付预付款17322000元，2011年11月支付进度款34644000元，2012年11月支付进度款34644000元，2016年10月支付400万元、11月支付800万元、12月支付200万元，2017年1月支付200万元。东方汽轮机公司就2017年5月17日前欠付的2400万元货款另行向大庆中院提起了诉讼。大丰建安公司就肇源项目合同履行过程中的损失、质量问题及违约金亦向黑龙江省大庆市中级人民法院提起了诉讼。
The court of first instance found the following facts:

In August 2011, Da'an Wind Power Branch of Dongfang Electric Corporation Dongfang Steam Turbine Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Da'an Branch) and Dafeng Construction and Installation Company entered into the Sales Contract (Contract No. DTC/C51C20112), which provided that: Dafeng Construction and Installation Company purchased 33 sets of FD82B low-temperature wind turbine generator sets (single unit capacity of 1.5MW or above) from Da'an Branch. The comprehensive unit price per kilowatt was 3,560 yuan/KW, with a total contract price of 173.22 million yuan. This included the wind turbine equipment, monitoring system, spare parts and consumables, special tools, and all taxes, fees, transportation and miscellaneous charges, insurance premiums, and technical documentation fees related to the equipment. In addition, the technical service fee was 3 million yuan, making the total amount 176.22 million yuan.

Upon the effective date of the contract, within 15 working days after receiving and verifying the performance guarantee (10% of the total contract price) and the financial receipt for 10% of the contract price from Da'an Branch, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company would pay 10% of the total contract price as an advance payment. Before shipment, Da'an Branch would submit a financial receipt for 20% of the contract price, and within 15 working days after verification, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company would pay 20% of the total contract price as a progress payment. After delivery of all 33 sets of equipment was completed, Da'an Branch would submit a financial receipt for 20% of the contract price and one VAT invoice for 100% of the contract price. Within 15 working days after verification, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company would pay 20% of the total contract price, and simultaneously return the bank performance guarantee for 5% of the total price. Within the first month of the fourth year from the date of pre-acceptance of all 33 sets of units, Da'an Branch would submit a financial receipt for 40% of the total price and the pre-acceptance certificate for the equipment jointly signed by Da'an Branch, the end-user, and Dafeng Construction and Installation Company. Within 15 working days after receiving and verifying the financial receipt and pre-acceptance certificate, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company would pay 40% of the total contract price, and simultaneously return the bank performance guarantee for 5% of the total price. Within the first year after all 33 sets of units passed final acceptance and the final acceptance certificate was jointly signed by the end-user, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company, and Da'an Branch, Da'an Branch would submit a financial receipt for 10% of the total price and the final acceptance certificate. Within 15 working days after receiving and verifying the financial receipt and final acceptance certificate, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company would pay 10% of the total contract price.

Upon passing the unit performance acceptance test and after the pre-acceptance certificate was signed by Dafeng Construction and Installation Company, Da'an Branch, and the end-user, Da'an Branch would submit a commercial invoice for 70% of the total technical service fee. After verification, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company would pay 70% of the technical service fee. After the end-user, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company, and Da'an Branch signed the final acceptance certificate, Da'an Branch would submit an invoice for 30% of the total technical service fee. After verification, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company would pay the remaining 30% of the technical service fee.

The delivery schedule and sequence of equipment were to meet the requirements of the construction and installation schedule and order, ensuring timely delivery and completeness of equipment. Tools, spare parts, and consumables would be shipped to the site together with the first batch of contract equipment. The place of delivery was the equipment installation site (vehicle side) of the Zhaoyuan Xinlong Shunde wind farm. The supply schedule was: delivery of 11 sets from October 30 to November 30, 2011; delivery of 11 sets from December 1 to December 30, 2011; and delivery of 11 sets from January 1 to January 30, 2012. The exact supply time was subject to a written notice from Dafeng Construction and Installation Company three months in advance.

On October 15, 2012, Da'an Branch and the owner of the wind turbine generator units at issue, Zhaoyuan Xinlong Shunde Wind Power Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xinlong Shunde Company), jointly conducted acceptance inspection of the 33 sets of wind turbine generator units, and signed and sealed the acceptance certificate. On November 5, 2012, Xinlong Shunde Company signed and sealed the report provided by Da'an Branch stating that the Daqing Zhaoyuan Xinlong Shunde wind farm formally entered the quality warranty period. It confirmed that the 33 wind turbines had completed the 240-hour acceptance test at 20:00 on November 4, 2012, that the turbines were operating normally and met the acceptance requirements, and that the quality warranty period officially began on November 6, 2012.

On April 18, 2016, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company and Dongfang Electric Company consulted on the payment and performance of the Linkou and Zhaoyuan projects, and produced the Meeting Minutes, which stated: The Zhaoyuan wind farm began delivery in December 2011. According to the contract, the pre-acceptance payment was to be made in the first month of the fourth year from the date of pre-acceptance. By October 2015, the acceptance payment of 71,388,000 yuan should have been paid. The quality guarantee deposit of 18,222,000 yuan would be paid within the first year after the final acceptance certificate was signed. The specific payment plan was: payments would start in May 2016, with a monthly payment of 2 million yuan. The remaining outstanding amount would be paid at a monthly rate of 6 million yuan from January 2017 until the pre-acceptance payment and quality guarantee deposit were fully paid by the end of 2017. If Dafeng Construction and Installation Company failed to pay according to the above payment plan, it would pay interest for the period of delay at the benchmark loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China for the corresponding period. For the Zhaoyuan project, Dongfang Electric Company had the right to suspend related support and operation and maintenance work from the month following the month in which payment was not made on time. Dongfang Electric Company would not bear any liability for any impact on the wind farm's power generation or any consequences or risks resulting from such suspension. Any costs incurred later due to rectification of components required for restarting after shutdown would be borne by Dafeng Construction and Installation Company.

On July 17, 2016, Dafeng Construction and Installation Company, Dafeng Service Company, and Dongfang Steam Turbine Company signed the Payment Guarantee Agreement, which provided: Da'an Branch is a branch of Dongfang Steam Turbine Company, and all rights and obligations under the Zhaoyuan Project are assumed by Dongfang Steam Turbine Company. The pre-acceptance payment and quality guarantee deposit payable under the Zhaoyuan Project totaled 89.61 million yuan. All amounts payable by Dafeng Construction and Installation Company to Da'an Branch would be paid directly to Dongfang Steam Turbine Company, and Da'an Branch's delivery obligations had been fully performed. The specific payment proportions, amounts, and deadlines remained as stipulated in the Meeting Minutes. Dafeng Service Company assumed joint and several suretyship liability for the payment of the Zhaoyuan Project.

Dafeng Construction and Installation Company paid an advance payment of 17,322,000 yuan in September 2011, a progress payment of 34,644,000 yuan in November 2011, a progress payment of 34,644,000 yuan in November 2012, and 4 million yuan in October 2016, 8 million yuan in November 2016, 2 million yuan in December 2016, and 2 million yuan in January 2017. Dongfang Steam Turbine Company separately filed a lawsuit in the Daqing Intermediate People's Court for the outstanding 24 million yuan in purchase price that was due before May 17, 2017. Dafeng Construction and Installation Company also filed a lawsuit in the Daqing Intermediate People's Court of Heilongjiang Province concerning losses, quality issues, and liquidated damages arising from the performance of the Zhaoyuan Project contract.

The court of first instance held that the Sales Contract signed between Da'an Branch and Dafeng Jian'an Company represented the true intention of both parties, its contents did not violate mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations regarding validity, and there were no other statutory circumstances rendering the contract void; therefore, it should be deemed valid. Da'an Branch performed all its supply obligations. Dafeng Jian'an Company paid an advance payment of RMB 17,322,000 in September 2011 as stipulated in the contract, and progress payments of RMB 34,644,000 in November 2011 and November 2012 respectively, totaling RMB 86.61 million. Regarding how to perform the payment of 40% of the total price within the first month of the fourth year from the date of pre-acceptance and the payment of 10% of the total price after final acceptance, Dafeng Jian'an Company and Dongfang Electric Company, after consultation on April 18, 2016, formed the Meeting Minutes, which specified the payment time and standards. These were confirmed by the signatures and seals of both parties and were legally valid. Dafeng Jian'an Company's defense claim that the Meeting Minutes were invalid lacked factual and legal basis and could not be established. Although Dafeng Jian'an Company objected to the acceptance certificate provided by Dongfang Turbine Company and argued that the acceptance act as stipulated in the contract had not been completed and the payment conditions had not been fulfilled, the contents of the Meeting Minutes involved in the case indicated that both parties had changed the payment conditions stipulated in the contract. Dafeng Jian'an Company had partially performed the agreement, and it should pay the outstanding货款, service fees, and return the quality guarantee bond in accordance with the Meeting Minutes. On July 17, 2016, Dafeng Jian'an Company, Dafeng Service Company, and Dongfang Turbine Company signed the Payment Guarantee Agreement, which stipulated that all rights and obligations of the Zhaoyuan Project were assumed by Dongfang Turbine Company, and Dafeng Service Company voluntarily assumed joint and several guarantee liability for the payment of the Zhaoyuan Project. This agreement did not violate legal provisions and was legally valid. Dafeng Service Company's defense claim that the Payment Guarantee Agreement was invalid also lacked legal basis. As the agreement did not specify the guarantee period, according to Article 26, paragraph 1 of the Security Law of the PRC, which provides that "where a guarantor of joint and several guarantee and the creditor have not agreed on the guarantee period, the creditor has the right to demand the guarantor to assume the guarantee liability within six months from the date of expiration of the principal debt performance period," the final payment date of the debt involved in the case was December 31, 2017. By the time Dongfang Turbine Company filed this lawsuit on April 24, 2018, the six-month guarantee period had not expired. Therefore, Dafeng Jian'an Company should pay the outstanding货款 to Dongfang Turbine Company, and Dafeng Service Company should bear joint and several liability for such payment. Given that the scope of Dafeng Service Company's guarantee did not include the litigation costs for realizing the creditor's rights, that part of Dongfang Turbine Company's claim was not supported. After the signing of the Meeting Minutes involved in the case, Dafeng Jian'an Company paid RMB 16 million in货款. Dongfang Turbine Company separately filed a lawsuit for the RMB 24 million in货款 due as of the end of April 2017. Therefore, the total outstanding货款, service fees, and quality guarantee bond to be returned amounted to RMB 49.61 million. Dafeng Jian'an Company's failure to pay on time constituted a breach of contract. According to the agreement, the amount should be paid in monthly installments of RMB 6 million starting from May 2017, with the balance fully paid by December 2017. Given that Dafeng Jian'an Company had instituted separate proceedings regarding quality issues and Dongfang Turbine Company's liability for breach of contract, it was obligated to pay the aforesaid amounts and should pay interest for overdue payment based on the monthly payment amounts, time, and the benchmark interest rate for loans of the same period published by the People's Bank of China. Dafeng Service Company should bear joint and several liability for this. In summary, Dongfang Turbine Company's claims were established and were supported by the court. In accordance with Articles 8, 60, and 107 of the Contract Law of the PRC and Article 26 of the Security Law of the PRC, the judgment was as follows: 1. Dafeng Jian'an Company shall, within 10 days from the effective date of this judgment, pay Dongfang Turbine Company the principal of the overdue amount, RMB 49.61 million, and interest (from May to November 2017, RMB 6 million per month was due, and in December 2017, RMB 7.61 million was due; interest shall be calculated from the date each payment became overdue to the date of actual payment, based on the benchmark interest rate for loans of the same period published by the People's Bank of China); 2. Dafeng Service Company shall bear joint and several liability for the aforesaid amounts; 3. Dongfang Turbine Company's other claims were dismissed. The court acceptance fee for the first instance, RMB 295,137.85, shall be borne by Dafeng Jian'an Company.

In addition to confirming the facts found by the court of first instance, this Court further finds the following:

I. Article 4.2.5 of the Sales Contract stipulates: "Within the first year after all wind turbine generators (33 sets) pass the final acceptance and the final acceptance certificate is issued by the end-user, buyer, and seller, the seller shall submit one financial receipt for 10% of the total price of the contract equipment and five copies of the final acceptance certificate. The buyer shall, within 15 working days after receiving and verifying the financial receipt and the final acceptance certificate, pay the seller 10% of the price of the contract equipment." Article 4.3 stipulates: "Payment of technical service fees: After the contract equipment passes the unit performance acceptance test and the pre-acceptance certificate is signed by the buyer, seller, and end-user, the seller shall submit a commercial invoice for 70% of the total technical service fee for the contract equipment. After the buyer verifies it, the buyer shall pay the seller 70% of the technical service fee for the contract equipment; after the contract equipment passes the final acceptance and the buyer, seller, and end-user sign the final acceptance certificate, the seller shall submit an invoice for 30% of the total technical service fee for the contract equipment. After the buyer verifies it, the buyer shall pay the seller the remaining 30% of the technical service fee for the contract equipment." Article 9.6 stipulates: "The 'quality guarantee period' shall commence after obtaining the 'pre-acceptance certificate.' The quality guarantee period for the entire wind turbine generator set shall be 60 months...".

II. On February 29, 2016, Dafeng Jian'an Company sent a letter (Dafeng Jian'an Letter [2016] No. 1) to Dongfang Electric Company, which stated: "...The pre-acceptance certificate was signed in October 2012. According to the agreement, the payment deadline was January 31, 2016. Up to now, RMB 2,100,000 in technical service fees for the equipment have not been paid, and the total amount payable is RMB 71,388,000. Based on our company's current financial situation, after research and in the spirit of good-faith cooperation, we propose the following payment plan and commitment for the above amount...".

III. The Meeting Minutes stated: "The Zhaoyuan Wind Farm started delivery in December 2011. According to Article 4.2.4 of the contract, the pre-acceptance payment shall be made in the first month of the fourth year from the date of signing the pre-acceptance certificate. By October 2015, the acceptance payment of RMB 71,388,000 should have been paid. According to Article 4.2.5 of the contract, the quality guarantee bond of RMB 18,222,000 shall be paid within the first year after the final acceptance certificate is signed... After friendly consultation between the two parties, the following specific contents regarding the repayment of the Zhaoyuan and Linkou projects and the delivery of Linkou goods have been agreed...".

IV. Dafeng Jian'an Company stated that during the performance of the Sales Contract in this case, it did not raise any written quality objections. It was not until after 2018 that Dafeng Jian'an Company filed a lawsuit regarding the quality issues of the wind turbine generators. The Daqing Intermediate People's Court of Heilongjiang Province accepted the case on May 10, 2018.

This Court holds that the issues in dispute in this appeal are as follows: 1. Whether Dongfang Turbine Company unilaterally changed the contract contents and improperly facilitated the fulfillment of payment conditions; 2. Whether the goods underwent pre-acceptance and whether Dongfang Turbine Company concealed the fact that pre-acceptance did not occur; 3. Whether Dafeng Jian'an Company's assertion of the right to defense of first performance on the ground of quality issues in the goods can be established; 4. Whether Dongfang Turbine Company fulfilled its delivery obligations in accordance with the contract; 5. Whether Dongfang Turbine Company has the right to take back the RMB 18.222 million "quality guarantee bond." Regarding the above issues, this Court analyzes them one by one as follows:

1. Whether Dongfang Turbine Company unilaterally changed the contract contents and improperly facilitated the fulfillment of payment conditions

Dafeng Jian'an Company argued that Dongfang Electric Company's signing of the Meeting Minutes exceeded the agreement in the Wind Power Business Entrustment Agreement and unilaterally changed the contract contents. However, the Meeting Minutes were freely negotiated and agreed upon by Dafeng Jian'an Company and Dongfang Electric Company, which was authorized by Dongfang Turbine Company. The contents did not violate legal provisions and were not a unilateral change of the contract by Dongfang Turbine Company. The Meeting Minutes changed the payment time, etc., as originally stipulated in the contract, which was also an independent transaction arrangement by both parties. Dongfang Turbine Company did not unilaterally change the contract contents or improperly facilitate the fulfillment of payment conditions.

2. Whether the goods underwent pre-acceptance and whether Dongfang Turbine Company concealed the fact that pre-acceptance did not occur

According to the Sales Contract, pre-acceptance should be carried out jointly by the end-user, buyer, and seller. Although Dafeng Jian'an Company did not participate in the pre-acceptance in this case, which did not comply with the Sales Contract, in the letter from Dafeng Jian'an Company to Dongfang Electric Company on February 29, 2016 (Dafeng Jian'an Letter [2016] No. 1), Dafeng Jian'an Company expressly acknowledged the signing time of the acceptance certificate and promised to pay the pre-acceptance payment in installments. Therefore, Dafeng Jian'an Company was fully aware of and acknowledged the pre-acceptance previously carried out by Da'an Branch and the owner, Xinlong Shunde Company. Dongfang Turbine Company did not conceal the pre-acceptance situation. The subsequent Meeting Minutes and Payment Guarantee Agreement further clarified this, and Dafeng Jian'an Company also actually performed part of the payment obligation for the pre-acceptance payment. Therefore, Dafeng Jian'an Company's defense that it refused to pay the货款 on the ground that the project had not undergone pre-acceptance cannot be established.

3. Whether Dafeng Jian'an Company's assertion of the right to defense of first performance on the ground of quality issues in the goods can be established

From the signing of the Sales Contract in 2011 when Dongfang Turbine Company began supplying the goods, until 2018, Dafeng Jian'an Company never formally raised any quality objections. It was only after Dongfang Turbine Company filed a lawsuit for recovery of货款 in October 2017 that Dafeng Jian'an Company filed a separate lawsuit regarding quality issues in 2018, alleging that Dongfang Turbine Company's supply had quality problems and seeking damages. As the quality issue has been handled in a separate case, Dafeng Jian'an Company's rights can be pursued in that separate action. Therefore, the court of first instance was correct in not addressing the quality dispute. This Court does not support Dafeng Jian'an Company's claim that it has the right to defense of first performance due to quality issues.

4. Whether Dongfang Turbine Company fulfilled its delivery obligations in accordance with the contract

The 33 wind turbine generators involved in the case were inspected upon delivery and subsequently underwent pre-acceptance. The goods had been delivered to the owner, Xinlong Shunde Company, and put into use. By the time the dispute over货款 arose between the parties, more than four years had passed. Dafeng Jian'an Company did not provide evidence to prove that it or the owner, Xinlong Shunde Company, had ever raised objections regarding Dongfang Turbine Company's failure to deliver the technical documentation for the wind turbines. Nor was there any situation where the wind turbines could not operate due to the lack of technical documentation or otherwise failed to achieve the purpose of the contract. On the contrary, in item 1 of the Payment Guarantee Agreement signed on July 17, 2016, Dafeng Jian'an Company expressly acknowledged that "the supply obligation of Da'an Branch has been fulfilled." In terms of nature, the delivery of technical materials is an ancillary obligation of the seller. If the seller breaches this ancillary obligation, the buyer may claim corresponding liability for breach of contract. Unless the seller's breach of this ancillary obligation prevents the buyer from using the purchased goods normally and affects the realization of the contract purpose, the buyer cannot refuse to perform the principal obligation of paying the货款 based on the non-performance of the ancillary obligation. Therefore, even if Dongfang Turbine Company indeed failed to deliver the technical documentation for the wind turbines, Dafeng Jian'an Company could not refuse to pay the货款 solely on this ground.

5. Whether Dongfang Turbine Company has the right to take back the RMB 18.222 million "quality guarantee bond"

Dafeng Jian'an Company argued that, according to Article 4.2.5 of the Sales Contract, within the first year after all wind turbine generators pass the final acceptance and the final acceptance certificate is issued by the end-user, buyer, and seller, the buyer should return 10% of the quality guarantee payment (i.e., RMB 18.222 million). Since the equipment supplied by Dongfang Turbine Company had serious quality problems and Dongfang Turbine Company refused to repair them, the aforesaid quality guarantee bond of RMB 18.222 million should belong to Dafeng Jian'an Company. However, based on the facts found by this Court, Article 4.2.5 of the Sales Contract does not stipulate a quality guarantee bond or its return; instead, it provides that after the final acceptance, Dafeng Jian'an Company shall pay 10% of the price of the contract equipment. Throughout the entire Sales Contract, there is no provision that Dongfang Turbine Company should pay a quality guarantee bond of RMB 18.222 million or that it can claim its return after the final acceptance. According to Articles 4.2.5 and 4.3 of the Sales Contract, after the final acceptance, the amounts Dafeng Jian'an Company should pay to Dongfang Turbine Company include two items: first, 10% of the equipment price, and second, 30% of the technical service fee for the equipment. The sum of these two items is exactly RMB 18.222 million (RMB 173,220,000 x 10% + RMB 3,000,000 x 30%). Therefore, the statement in the Meeting Minutes that "according to Article 4.2.5 of the contract, the quality guarantee bond of RMB 18,222,000 shall be paid within the first year after the signing of the final acceptance certificate" was likely a clerical error. Dafeng Jian'an Company's claim that the RMB 18.222 million quality guarantee bond should belong to it cannot be established.

Even if the Meeting Minutes changed the agreement in the Sales Contract, treating the last payment of 10% of the equipment price and 30% of the technical service fee, totaling RMB 18.222 million, which was originally payable by Dafeng Jian'an Company after the final acceptance, as a quality guarantee bond, Dafeng Jian'an Company should still return it and has no right to retain the amount. According to Article 9.6 of the Sales Contract, the wind turbine generators enter the quality guarantee period after obtaining the pre-acceptance certificate, with a quality guarantee period of 5 years. The quality guarantee period in this case began on November 6, 2012, and ended on November 6, 2017. During this period, Dafeng Jian'an Company did not raise any quality objections or notify Dongfang Turbine Company. According to Article 158 of the Contract Law of the PRC, this should be deemed as the subject matter conforming to the agreement in terms of quality. After the expiration of the quality guarantee period, Dafeng Jian'an Company should pay the RMB 18.222 million to Dongfang Turbine Company by the end of 2017 in accordance with the mutual agreement.

In conclusion, Dafeng Jian'an Company's appeal claims cannot be established and should be dismissed. The judgment of the court of first instance had clear findings of fact and correct application of law, and should be affirmed. In accordance with Article 170, paragraph 1, item 1 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the judgment is as follows:

The appeal is dismissed, and the original judgment is affirmed.

The court acceptance fee for the second instance, RMB 295,137.85, shall be borne by Daqing High-tech Industrial Development Zone Dafeng Construction and Installation Co., Ltd.

This judgment is final.
